message.frieren_arcana.created: Barrier formed • radius %s • until released or shattered
spell.frieren_arcana.examination_barrier: An enduring sealed sphere. Blocks both directions, including its caster. Recast or use the Release Sigil to dismiss your field.
spell.frieren_arcana.defensive_barrier.g: An enduring defensive sphere. Creatures can pass; incoming projectiles and attacks cannot. Recast to dismiss.
spell.frieren_arcana.barrier_breaker.gui: Hover and launch dark green magic. Angular refracting cracks spread from impact, then the round dome collapses. Full mana required; Iron cooldown defaults to 90 seconds. R or Escape skips the camera.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.barrier_brea: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Barrier Breaker — Height of Magic
spell.frieren_arcana.mana_sight.guide: Toggle visible mana auras and read a targeted player’s apparent Iron’s Spellbooks mana. Concealment can fool this sight.
spell.frieren_arcana.zoltraak.guide: A focused beam of ordinary offensive magic. Blocked by terrain and barriers. Does not break terrain.
spell.frieren_arcana.flight.guide: Hold a staff in either hand. Double-tap jump for ordinary flight. A staff appears beneath you. Mana drains only while flying.
spell.frieren_arcana.mana_concealment.gu: Toggle suppression of your visible mana aura. Your actual mana remains usable. Persists through logout.
message.frieren_arcana.error.limit: The dimension has reached its active barrier limit.
message.frieren_arcana.error.height: The sphere must fit between the world’s build limits.
message.frieren_arcana.error.border: The sphere must fit inside the world border.
message.frieren_arcana.error.overlap: Barrier surfaces cannot intersect. Place the sphere fully inside or outside another field.
message.frieren_arcana.error.full_mana: Barrier Breaker requires your full equipped mana capacity.
message.frieren_arcana.error.cooldown: This spell is still recovering. Relogging will not reset it.
message.frieren_arcana.error.target: Aim directly at an Arcana barrier within 128 blocks.
message.frieren_arcana.barrage_on: Barrage active. Cast again or press Stop to end.
message.frieren_arcana.error.staff: Flight requires a staff in either hand.
message.frieren_arcana.error.endgame: Heavy Blast requires endgame mana capacity. Check the spell tooltip.
message.frieren_arcana.error.mastery: Master level V Zoltraak or equip the legendary Heavy Blast spell.
message.frieren_arcana.error.book: Equip a spellbook or imbued item containing Arcana Zoltraak or the chosen variant.
message.frieren_arcana.error.water: Reamstroha requires nearby water within 5 blocks.
message.frieren_arcana.error.living_targ: Aim at a living target within 24 blocks.
info.frieren_arcana.barrage_drain: Barrage drain: %s mana/second; no regeneration while active
info.frieren_arcana.heavy: Minimum capacity: %s mana; minimum charge: %s seconds
info.frieren_arcana.device_release: Use again to dismiss your examination field for free.
spell.frieren_arcana.zoltraak_barrage.gu: Toggle four focused shots per second. Continuously drains mana and suppresses regeneration until stopped or exhausted. Keep the spell equipped.
spell.frieren_arcana.zoltraak_heavy.guid: A wide, multi-target beam with an endgame mana requirement and a long minimum charge. Terrain and barriers stop it. No terrain destruction.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.zoltraak_hea: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Zoltraak — Heavy Blast
spell.frieren_arcana.nephtear.guide: Anime: Lawine-inspired spread of ice lances; damage, freezing and slowing. Five levels increase power and lance count.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.nephtear: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Nephtear — Ice Arrows
spell.frieren_arcana.reamstroha.guide: Anime: Kanne-inspired wide water attack. Requires existing nearby water; five levels. Does not create or consume fluid blocks.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.reamstroha: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Reamstroha — Water Control
spell.frieren_arcana.balgrant.guide: Anime: Richter-inspired graphical earth pillars damage and lift nearby foes. Five levels; leaves terrain intact.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.balgrant: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Balgrant — Earth Control
spell.frieren_arcana.jilwer.guide: Anime: Laufen-inspired speed burst. Three levels increase speed and duration. Barriers still confine movement.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.jilwer: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Jilwer — Swift Movement
spell.frieren_arcana.sorganeil.guide: Anime: Wirbel-inspired restraint. Hold the target in your view; releases on lost sight, death or logout. Three levels extend maximum duration.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.sorganeil: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Sorganeil — Sight Binding
spell.frieren_arcana.reelseiden.guide: Anime: Ubel-inspired short-range sweeping cut. Five-block range, five levels. Cannot cut Arcana barriers or terrain.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.reelseiden: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Reelseiden — Cutting Magic
spell.frieren_arcana.flower_field.guide: Anime: Flamme-inspired cosmetic flowers for 15 seconds. Three levels expand the field. No blocks are placed.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.flower_field: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Field of Flowers
spell.frieren_arcana.goddess_healing.gui: Anime-inspired self-healing and regeneration. Three levels improve recovery. Gameplay adaptation of priest magic.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.goddess_heal: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Goddess Magic — Healing
spell.frieren_arcana.goddess_cleansing.g: Anime-inspired self-cleanse: poison and wither; level II also removes slowing, level III blindness.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.goddess_clea: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Goddess Magic — Cleansing
spell.frieren_arcana.golden_transmutatio: Manga spoiler: temporary golden restraint for 10 seconds. One legendary level. Gameplay adaptation, not permanent canonical transmutation.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.golden_trans: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Golden Transmutation — Macht-inspired
message.frieren_arcana.error.bound: You cannot cast while magically restrained.
spell.frieren_arcana.vollzanbel.guide: Anime-inspired area fire burst. Three levels increase damage and radius. Ignites visible foes; leaves terrain intact.
spell.frieren_arcana.judradjim.guide: Anime-inspired aimed lightning burst with branching arcs. Three levels increase damage and radius. No uncontrolled lightning entities.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.judradjim: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Judradjim — Ruinous Lightning
spell.frieren_arcana.waldgose.guide: Anime-inspired wind burst that damages and lifts nearby foes. Five levels. Leaves a four-second wind window for Daosdorg.
spell.frieren_arcana.daosdorg.guide: Anime-inspired follow-up: cast within four seconds of your Tornado to ignite its location. Five levels. Does not set blocks on fire.
spell.frieren_arcana.catastrovia.guide: Anime-inspired piercing line of judgment light. Five levels. Hits multiple aligned targets; terrain and Arcana barriers stop it.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.catastrovia: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Catastrovia — Judgment Light
spell.frieren_arcana.jubelade.guide: Anime-inspired cutting petals. Requires nearby flower blocks or your cosmetic flower field. Five levels. Does not consume flowers.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.jubelade: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Jubelade — Steel Petals
spell.frieren_arcana.dragate.guide: Anime-inspired spread of 3–7 stone shots. Five levels increase count and power. Does not harvest or break terrain.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.dragate: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Dragate — Stone Bullets
spell.frieren_arcana.object_levitation.g: Channel to grab a creature or dropped item within 12/14/16 blocks and move it with your aim. Uses Iron Telekinesis for creatures. H throws the target. Costs 25 mana per channel pulse; releases when casting stops.
spell.frieren_arcana.goddess_three_spear: Anime-inspired fan of three radiant attacks. Three levels increase power. Damage invulnerability, terrain and barriers still apply.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.goddess_thre: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Goddess Magic — Three Spears
jei.frieren_arcana.inscription: Use Iron's inscription system to install this scroll in a spellbook. This guide describes spell behavior; it is not a crafting recipe.
jei.frieren_arcana.reference: Reference page; no recipe transfer. Hover the scroll for full spell details.
jei.frieren_arcana.staff: Hold this staff, an Iron's staff, or a tagged flight staff in either hand to fly. The other hand remains available. A staff is shown below the flying player. Crafting is shown in JEI's normal crafting category.
jei.frieren_arcana.release: Right-click to release both of your saved barrier types. Dismissal is free. Other players cannot dismiss your barriers with this item.
jei.frieren_arcana.device: Reusable examination dome device. Right-click to create its tier size; use again to release your existing field for free. Shared owner slot with Examination Barrier. The whole sphere must fit world height and borders. No duration or upkeep. Crafting/upgrade recipes are in JEI's crafting category.
message.frieren_arcana.error.flowers: Steel Petals requires nearby flowers or your cosmetic flower field.
message.frieren_arcana.error.wind: Cast your Tornado first, then Fire-Wind within four seconds.
message.frieren_arcana.error.item_target: Aim at a creature or dropped item
spell.frieren_arcana.barrier_breaker.sum: Pierces and shatters one Arcana barrier
spell.frieren_arcana.sorganeil.summary: Binds a target while you watch it
spell.frieren_arcana.object_levitation.s: Grab and move targets; H throws
